claims.statement: Tom Allen, Charley Gallagher and Mike McCoole were permanent residents of St. Louis.
claims.excerpt:
Allen, Gallagher and McCoole are permanent resi-
depts and permanent attractions

claims.statement: Tom Allen was one of three champions in St. Louis, along with Charley Gallagher and Mike McCoole, each ready to wear the belt.
claims.excerpt:
Allen, Gallagher and McCoole are permanent resi-
depts and permanent attractions

claims.statement: Tom Allen's saloon, a 'Concert Saloon' on Fifth Street between Biddle and O'Fallon streets, had a bar in front and a back room with tables and a piano.
claims.excerpt:
This establishment is on Fitth, between Biddle and
O’Falion streets
places: Fifth Street between Biddle and O'Fallon streets, St. Louis

claims.statement: Tom Allen and Charley Gallagher were expected to fight on August 17, 1869, and were keeping out of sight until the fight was ready to start.
claims.excerpt:
Messrs. Allen and Gallagher propose to keep them-
selves out of sight until the ball is ready to open,

claims.statement: Tom Allen and Charley Gallagher were expected to join the excursion steamer at some point beyond the city.
claims.excerpt:
and will probably jom the steamer at some point be-
yond the city.

claims.statement: Tom Allen was understood to be in fine condition on the day of the fight.

notes: The paper's 'Concert Saloon' description is the source for the saloon claim. The hint that patrons were mostly English describes the saloon's crowd, not Allen, so it is not recorded.
